description: Before commit: verify tests pass AND no forbidden content (secrets, private keys, seeds, wallet addresses beyond the public example, mint/broadcast code) is staged. Report-only by design — this hook is the gate.

actions.failMessage: Forbidden content found (secret / seed / broadcast code) in server/ or tests/. Remove it before committing.

actions.command: git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '^\.kiro/' && echo '.kiro present in commit' || (echo 'WARNING: .kiro not in this commit — Kiroween requires /.kiro at the repo root' && exit 1)
